title: Advance to the next author gate
description: Run the next writing actions automatically and stop when only the author can decide.

conditions: Portable project state has been initialized
The host provides a driver that selects each step from project state and confines it to that step's contract

delegation.purpose: Design a coherent section and argument structure from the project evidence when the driver selects create-outline
Synthesize existing and newly discovered evidence into a section research brief when the driver selects research-gap
Create an executable plan grounded in project intent and evidence when the driver selects plan-section
Check plan completeness, traceability, and feasibility before approval when the driver selects plan-section
Draft the section from its approved plan and evidence when the driver selects write-section
Independently verify claim, evidence, and requirement coverage when the driver selects write-section
Independently assess the section against its plan, evidence, and selected review perspective when the driver selects review-section
